envelope_scorer.not_computed_rationale: W13 option (b), schema AMENDMENT 9. The teacher-forced per-token ranking this scorer produces is not the agent's action distribution under any normalization or surface, so the three envelopes, explanatory_divergence and surprisal are recorded as not measured rather than as numbers describing something else.
envelope_scorer.surprisal_denominator: 13 when the taken action is one of them exactly; otherwise 14 (the 13 plus the taken action). Recorded per action in actions[].surprisal_basis
envelope_scorer.threshold_provenance: PROHIBITION_OUT_CEILING and DECLARED_IN_ENVELOPE_FLOOR were calibrated on the TEXT surface (envelope-preregistration.md §4). This cell scores the CHAT surface. The thresholds have no chat-surface negative control behind them yet
